checks: provided non-null critical decision step IDs exist in the trace
additional_fields: ignored at every level; preserved in original output
evidence_audit: reported separately; not part of CodeTracer-compatible acceptance
semantic_review: reported separately; acceptance does not certify diagnosis correctness
local_adaptations: preserve string step IDs without coercion
upstream container TypeError becomes validation failure rather than a crash
historical_experiments: retain original strict results; revalidate in a separate versioned report
legacy_strict_diagnosis_audits: not run by current entrypoints; retained only in historical research code and saved records
replay_integrity: source hashes and exact recorded-output replay check material identity, not diagnosis acceptance or truth
